01地缘与安全 · 2026年11月16日

黑海无人机袭击触发罗马尼亚战机升空

Black Sea Drone Attacks Trigger Romanian Fighter Jet Scramble

Three merchant ships were hit by drones over the weekend near Romania's Sulina Canal, among them the Greek-flagged product tanker Evia Petrol V, the St Kitts-flagged bulker Marsol and the product tanker Ali Najafov. Romania scrambled fighter jets twice in response. A fourth vessel, the Palau-flagged cargo ship Larissa 1, was struck near Sfântu Gheorghe on Friday night, its crane damaged.

周末三艘商船在罗马尼亚苏利纳运河附近遭无人机袭击，包括希腊籍成品油轮 Evia Petrol V、圣基茨籍散货船 Marsol 和成品油轮 Ali Najafov。罗马尼亚两次出动战机应对。另有帕劳旗货船 Larissa 1 周五晚在 Sfântu Gheorghe 附近被击中，起重机受损。

02地缘与安全 · 2026年11月16日

油价下跌：霍尔木兹出口恢复强化供应过剩预期

Oil Falls as Recovering Middle East Exports Bolster Surplus Outlook

Oil fell as recovering Middle East exports reinforced expectations of a supply surplus. The IEA says the global oil market will return to surplus in the fourth quarter, with supply averaging 105 million barrels a day, some 1.7 million b/d above demand. Risk has not disappeared: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said two tankers hit mines and exploded in Hormuz on Monday, with six tankers catching fire across Sunday and Monday.

中东出口恢复强化了供应过剩预期，油价下跌。国际能源署（IEA）称四季度全球石油市场将重回过剩，供应日均1.05亿桶，比需求高170万桶/日。风险并未消退：伊朗革命卫队称周一两艘油轮在霍尔木兹触雷爆炸，周日至周一共六艘油轮起火。

03海事安全与法规 · 2026年11月16日

新奥尔良油轮撞沉游船：转向故障是主因

Steering Failure Blamed for New Orleans Tanker-Cruise Ship Collision

Preliminary NTSB analysis shows the asphalt tanker Atlantic Asphalt's rudder jammed to starboard at 12:26 on 13 November; two minutes later it hit the berthed river cruise ship American Heritage, which capsized within 22 minutes. The cruise ship carried 140 passengers and 50 crew; 32 people were taken to hospital and there were no deaths. Four crew members have sued tanker owner Nave Shipping and manager OSM Thome, and the Port of New Orleans is claiming more than $1m.

美国国家运输安全委员会（NTSB）初步分析显示，沥青油轮 Atlantic Asphalt 于11月13日12:26方向舵卡死向右舷，两分钟后撞上停泊的内河游船 American Heritage，游船在22分钟内倾覆。游船载有140名乘客、50名船员，32人送医，无死亡。另有四名船员已起诉油轮船东 Nave Shipping 与管理公司 OSM Thome，新奥尔良港索赔超100万美元。

04海事安全与法规 · 2026年11月16日

美国《琼斯法案》豁免再延90天至明年2月

US Extends Jones Act Waiver into February

The US Department of Homeland Security has approved a third extension of the Jones Act waiver, with the new waiver period running from 16 November and cargoes required to be loaded by 23:59 Eastern on 14 February 2027. Foreign-flagged ships must still obtain approval voyage by voyage. The waiver was first introduced in March, when the Iran war disrupted energy supplies.

美国国土安全部批准《琼斯法案》豁免第三次延期，新豁免期自11月16日起，货物须在2027年2月14日23:59（美东时间）前装船。外国旗船仍须逐航次单独获批。该豁免最初于3月因伊朗战争扰动能源供应而推出。

05海事安全与法规 · 2026年11月16日

挪威最高法院裁定三个海上油气项目批复无效

Norway's Court Invalidates Approvals for Three Offshore Developments

Norway's Supreme Court ruled on 13 November, in a decision reported by Splash247 on 16 November, that government approvals for Equinor's Breidablikk and Aker BP's Tyrving and Yggdrasil developments are invalid because combustion emissions — scope 3 emissions — were not properly assessed; all 11 justices agreed such an assessment is required. The ruling does not automatically revoke the licences or halt production: the energy ministry must review the approvals again, and Yggdrasil is planned to start up in 2027.

挪威最高法院11月13日裁决（Splash247 于11月16日报道），政府对 Equinor 的 Breidablikk、Aker BP 的 Tyrving 与 Yggdrasil 三个项目的批复无效，因为批复时未充分评估燃烧排放（范围三排放），11名法官一致认为必须评估。裁决不自动撤销许可或停产，能源部须重新审核；Yggdrasil 计划2027年投产。

06海事安全与法规 · 2026年11月16日

印度放宽船旗规则以扩大本国船队

India Eases Flag Rules in Push for More Tonnage

India has lowered the ownership threshold for its flag from full Indian ownership to an Indian shareholding of more than 50%, allowing foreign minority investment, under a government notice issued pursuant to the Merchant Shipping Act, 2025. New Delhi is also pushing ahead with the Bharat Container Shipping Line alongside ship finance, insurance and shipbuilding initiatives.

印度将本国船旗资格的所有权门槛由全部印度所有放宽至印度持股超50%，允许外国少数股权投资，依据2025年《商船法》发布的政府公告执行。印度同时推进 Bharat Container Shipping Line，以及船舶融资、保险与造船举措。

希腊船东就 IMO 僵局向布鲁塞尔发难

Greek Shipowners Put Brussels on the Spot over IMO Deadlock

Melina Travlos, president of the Union of Greek Shipowners, has warned that EU unwillingness to compromise could deadlock the IMO again at the working group meeting on 23–27 November and at MEPC 85 on 30 November–3 December. Greece and three other countries control about 70% of Europe's fleet, and owners want one global rulebook rather than overlapping regional regulation. Talks centre on the IMO net-zero framework: a global marine fuel standard combined with emissions pricing.

希腊船东联盟主席 Melina Travlos 警告，欧盟不愿妥协可能使 IMO 在11月23–27日工作组会议及11月30日–12月3日 MEPC 85 上再度陷入僵局。希腊等四国控制欧洲约70%的船队，船东要求全球统一规则，而非区域重叠监管。谈判焦点是 IMO 净零框架，即全球船用燃料标准加排放定价。

ONE 恢复苏伊士运河通行

Ocean Network Express Resumes Suez Canal Transits

ONE's ONE CONTINUITY transited the Suez Canal on Sunday 15 November with a southbound convoy, sailing from Singapore to the Netherlands on the Premier Alliance FE1 service — the carrier's first Red Sea–Suez voyage in about three years. Three further Premier Alliance services are expected to resume transits, and the canal route shortens Asia–Europe voyages.

ONE 的 ONE CONTINUITY 号11月15日（周日）随南行船队通过苏伊士运河，从新加坡驶往荷兰，属 Premier Alliance FE1 航线，为该公司约三年来首次经红海—苏伊士航行。另有三条 Premier Alliance 航线预计恢复通行，经运河可缩短亚欧航程。

香港船东世家面临接班考验

Hong Kong's Shipowner Dynasties Face the Succession Test

Families founded by Y.K. Pao, C.Y. Tung and Chao Tsong-yea built Hong Kong's shipowning standing; now third- and fourth-generation succession, and whether capital stays, are the tests. Members of the Hong Kong Shipowners Association own, manage or operate about 180 million dwt. Wah Kwong is in third-generation hands and plans to operate 50–60 ships before 2030, while Pacific Basin has moved strategic decision-making to Singapore.

包玉刚、董浩云、赵从衍等家族奠定了香港船东地位，如今第三、四代接班与资本去留成为考验。香港船东会成员拥有、管理或运营约1.8亿载重吨。华光海运已由第三代掌舵，计划2030年前运营50–60艘船；太平洋航运已将战略决策移至新加坡。

油轮二手船交易破纪录：300亿美元易手

Tanker Secondhand Sales Smash Records with $30bn Changing Hands

Clarksons Research data show 588 tankers totalling 69.6 million dwt changed hands in the first ten months of 2026 for $29.7bn — already above the full-year record set in 2022 and close to double 2025's full-year $16.2bn. VLCCs accounted for 124 of the sales, and a five-year-old VLCC is now valued at $220m, up from $120m at the end of last year. Clarksons says VLCC spot earnings fell 41% last week to $304,482 a day, still at historic highs.

Clarksons Research 数据显示，2026年前十个月共588艘油轮、6,960万载重吨易手，交易额297亿美元，已超过2022年全年纪录，接近2025年全年162亿美元的两倍。其中 VLCC 占124艘，五年船龄 VLCC 估值达2.2亿美元，高于去年底的1.2亿美元。Clarksons 称 VLCC 即期收益上周跌41%至304,482美元/天，仍处历史高位。

没有特许状的“东印度公司”：船东与港口重建贸易融资

The East India Company Without a Charter

DP World's trade finance arm had financed more than $1bn by July 2025, backed by 32 financial institutions, with JPMorgan sharing risk with the port operator since June 2025. The Asian Development Bank puts the trade finance gap at $2.5 trillion. Carriers and port groups are bundling ships, terminals, cargo rights and finance into a single counterparty, with the spread of electronic bills of lading a key enabler.

DP World 贸易融资部门到2025年7月已融资超10亿美元，背后有32家金融机构，摩根大通自2025年6月起与该港口运营商共担风险。亚洲开发银行估计全球贸易融资缺口达2.5万亿美元。船公司与港口集团正把“船+码头+货权+融资”打包成一个对手方，电子提单的普及是关键推手。

日本测试岸基数字航路指令，推进自主航运

Japan Tests Digital Route Instructions in Autonomous Shipping Push

In trials in Mikawa Bay on 4–5 November, IHI used a domestically developed VDES terminal to send shore-recommended routes directly to two vessels, with crews able to confirm the instructions on electronic displays. The project is backed by Japan's NEDO, and VDES could become an alternative to AIS from 2028, supporting autonomous navigation and remote monitoring.

IHI 在三河湾11月4–5日的试验中，用国产 VDES 终端把岸基推荐航路直接传给两艘船，船员可在电子显示屏上确认。该项目获日本 NEDO 支持，VDES 有望2028年成为 AIS 的替代方案，支撑自主航行与远程监管。
